title: Framing Political Bias in Multilingual LLMs Across Pakistani Languages
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates LLMs on topics with deep religious and moral significance, such as blasphemy laws, religious minority rights, and moral legislation in an Islamic state. It specifically utilizes a culturally adapted Political Compass Test that includes religious value assessments and analyzes model outputs through 'morality' and 'Islamic legal influence' framing dimensions.
